verdict.rationale: Adyen documents a dedicated test environment and recommends testing the full client- and server-side integration there before going live. It also offers test credentials for different transaction types, and TEST endpoints exist across its tooling (the MCP server's --env=TEST flag and the commerce-suite-test base URL). However, nothing in the pack shows test cards covering every scenario or ways to simulate declines and disputes, and nothing confirms the test environment mirrors production. Missing for 10: explicit test card numbers per scenario, decline simulation in test mode, dispute/chargeback testing, evidence of production parity, independent hands-on corroboration.
